project.title: SharePoint 2016 Design

parentsummary.deliverables: Designed a SharePoint 2016 solution for SSC's Security Management and Governance teams to replace ad hoc Excel-based processes, delivering business process mapping and gap analysis, standardized metadata schema, Business Intake through Security Assessment milestone and funding recovery tracking workflows, and knowledge transfer to internal FTE staff.
parentsummary.outcomes: Replaced non-standardized Excel reporting with a structured SharePoint-based project management and reporting system covering Security Assessment and Audit processes across all Government of Canada departments, delivering improved data integrity, consistent metadata, and measurable workflow governance for SM&G teams.

challenge.summary: The client was implementing a SharePoint solution for managing and tracking tasks performed by a number of Security Management and Governance teams. Existing processes relied heavily on Microsoft Excel spreadsheets for reporting, with non-standardized content.

deliverables: Review the 'as-is' implementation and align it with the work methodologies and requirements for all SM&G teams

Using a simplified business process mapping and gap analysis strategy, created and refined key workflows to track the process from Business Intake, through Security Assessment (SA) process, and completion with milestone tracking and funding recovery tracking
Designed and enforced a standardized metadata schema and controlled vocabulary across the SharePoint system, eliminating non-standardized content and ensuring data integrity and reporting consistency
Implementation of consolidated data project management and reporting system for Security Assessment and Audit of projects across all GC departments
Facilitated requirements gathering with management and Director level to understand scope and high-level business process
Provided knowledge transfer and training to internal FTE staff

outcomes: Designed and delivered a SharePoint 2016 project management system replacing Excel-based ad hoc reporting for SSC Security Management and Governance teams across all Government of Canada departments
Standardized SM&G metadata schema and enforced data integrity, eliminating non-standardized content that had previously prevented consolidated reporting
Implemented Business Intake through Security Assessment milestone tracking and funding recovery workflows, providing end-to-end visibility into the SA process lifecycle for the first time
